import os
import openpyxl
from numbers import Number

spreadsheet_path = "/mnt/data/spreadsheet/587-38/1_587-38_input.xlsx"
output_path = "/mnt/data/outputs/587-38_0_855e0c0e/1_587-38_output.xlsx"

wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(spreadsheet_path)
ws1 = wb["Sheet1"]
ws2 = wb["Sheet2"]

# Locate relevant columns dynamically from the header row.
headers = {}
for cell in ws1[1]:
    if cell.value is not None:
        headers[str(cell.value).strip()] = cell.column

order_col = headers.get("OrderTypeSAP", 1)
name_col = headers.get("Name", 2)
material_start_col = headers.get("Material", 3)
count_col = headers.get("Result of Count", 11)

records = []

for row in range(2, ws1.max_row + 1):
    order_type = ws1.cell(row=row, column=order_col).value
    name = ws1.cell(row=row, column=name_col).value

    if order_type is None and name is None:
        continue

    material_values = []
    for col in range(material_start_col, count_col):
        val = ws1.cell(row=row, column=col).value
        if val is not None and val != "":
            material_values.append(val)

    count_val = ws1.cell(row=row, column=count_col).value
    if isinstance(count_val, Number):
        n = int(count_val)
    else:
        # Fallback equivalent to COUNT over the material area for these workbooks.
        n = len(material_values)

    for material in material_values[:n]:
        records.append([order_type, name, material])

# Only modify the allowed answer range Sheet2!G1:I12.
start_row, start_col = 1, 7
max_rows, max_cols = 12, 3

for r in range(max_rows):
    for c in range(max_cols):
        ws2.cell(row=start_row + r, column=start_col + c).value = None

for r, record in enumerate(records[:max_rows], start=start_row):
    for c, value in enumerate(record, start=start_col):
        ws2.cell(row=r, column=c).value = value

os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(output_path), exist_ok=True)
wb.save(output_path)
